supported_findings: Vision-CLS-selected top-32 patches have a positive selector-specific causal effect under development-stage mean replacement at vision.late and projector.output.
Logit-Concept-selected patches are null-compatible at both tested stages under the same intervention.
Vision-CLS selector-specific effects exceed Logit-Concept effects at both stages.
Correct CUB images improve teacher-forced correct-answer margin and margin accuracy over prompt-only, shuffled-image, and opposite-label-image controls in both LLaVA and Qwen.
suggestive_diagnostics: Selector-specific effects are larger on Phase 5 successes than failures.
Qwen has larger correct-image effects on its raw margin scale, but cross-architecture margin scales are not calibrated.

absence of evidence from a null-compatible interval
an internal causal route for Qwen
